description: ChinaGEOSS Data Sharing Network is a data network run by Chinese Academy of Sciences, Aerospace Information Research Institute. The network is the Chinese contribution to the Group on Earth Observations and gives a search portal over satellite imagery, land-cover, disaster-monitoring and environment data held by Chinese agencies and institutes. Coverage: China and global products. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, hdf; access is free of charge for most data with registration. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("ChinaGEOSS Data Sharing Network") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support remote-sensing based hazard and exposure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
